description: The health of the server’s disks, from their own SMART data. Sleeping disks are never woken up to read it.
summaryWarning: {count, plural, one {# needs attention} other {# need attention}}
summaryHot: {count, plural, one {# too hot} other {# too hot}}
loadError: Disk health could not be read.

notConfigured.title: Disk health is not set up
notConfigured.description: A small service reads the disks for Canopy: add it to your compose file and point the engine to it, as the disk health guide explains.

empty.title: No disk found
empty.description: The disks service sees no disk: list them under “devices” in its compose entry.

asleepHint: Spun down: these values are from its last reading.

reasons.smartFailed: The disk reports that it is failing: back up its data and replace it.
reasons.criticalWarning: The drive reports a critical warning: back up its data.
reasons.reallocated: Damaged sectors were replaced by spare ones.
reasons.pending: Some sectors could not be read and wait to be replaced.
reasons.uncorrectable: Some sectors could not be read at all.
reasons.mediaErrors: The drive met errors it could not correct.
reasons.wornOut: The drive is close to the end of its rated life.
reasons.lowSpare: The drive is running out of spare blocks.

stats.ageValue: {years, plural, =0 {} one {# year, } other {# years, }}{days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

selfTest.title: Self-test
selfTest.longHint: Several hours; the disk stays usable meanwhile.
selfTest.started: Self-test started: follow it in the operations.
